articles.summary: Socks, being the most ignorant clothing accessory, add color to your wardrobe and helps to keep your feet protected and dry throughout the day. Yet, how much do you really know about this fun clothing accessory? To help you catch up, here are five traditions around the world you likely never knew about socks.
articles.title: 5 Weird and Fun Sock Traditions from Across the World

articles.summary: As you peel them off after a long day you might ask yourself, why do socks leave marks on my legs? We’ll dive into this age-old question!
articles.title: Why Do Socks Leave Marks On My Legs?

articles.summary: Shoes without socks plus hot Indian weather is the perfect combo for stinky feet. Sweat causes bacterial growth and nasty odour. Even premium branded shoes without socks leave wounds, rashes and blisters to our feet due to friction between them. Socks protect your feet from dirt, pollution, tanning and heat in summers.
articles.title: Why avoiding socks in summers is against your health?
